_rationale: Budgets are gzip bytes of JavaScript requested while loading a route (production build, fixtures, desktop Chromium), set from the measured value plus about 8 percent headroom. Measured first-party gzip bytes (headroom in brackets): / 146431 (9.3%); /offers/*, /industries/* 146431 (about 9%); /what-we-do, /what-we-do/*, /solutions/*, /how-we-work and every other template 152783 (RichText and CmsImage client chunk), /work /insights /labs 153383 (client-side filter island), /labs/:type 147254, 404 page 145202; each new entry is the measurement rounded up to 8 percent. /contact is 186862 first-party (the enquiry form island, about 34 KB gzip over the other templates) plus 27685 third-party (Cloudflare Turnstile api.js). Third-party scripts are budgeted separately (maxThirdPartyJsGzipBytes, default 0) because their size changes without a deploy: only /contact may load one, with about 50 percent headroom. A budget is only raised in a PR that says why; the lab LCP and CLS values printed by the perf suite are advisory.
